sections.title: Sound of the letter ve
paragraphs: The letter is called (вэ) /vɛ/. Its main sound is heard in (вода) /vɐˈda/, which means water. This letter makes four sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your upper teeth with your lower lip. Push voiced air through the narrow gap. For the second sound, raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. For the third sound, keep your voice off so your throat does not shake. For the fourth sound, keep your voice off and lift your tongue. Touch your throat to feel when your voice turns on.

sections.title: Reading the letter ve
paragraphs: The letter sounds like (волк) /volk/ before hard vowels. It becomes palatalized before soft vowels, as in (ветер) /ˈvʲetʲɪr/ or (вид) /vʲit/. A palatalized sound is said with the tongue raised toward the roof of the mouth. At the end of a word, it sounds voiceless like in (остров) /ˈosintrəf/ or (вход) /fxot/. With a soft sign at the end of a word, it sounds like (кровь) /krofʲ/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not confuse the written letter with English b. The sound is like the v in vine, not the b in boat. Do not use both lips like the w in water. Always touch your upper teeth with your lower lip. When the letter stands at the end of a word, do not keep your voice on like in love. Turn your voice off so it sounds like the f in leaf.
